strings.(잠수정을 타고 도착한 수중 도시 아틀란티스. 비릿한 물냄새 뒤로 지상에: (You arrive by submarine in the underwater city of Atlantis. Beneath the briny smell of the water lies a peculiar atmosphere unlike anything on the surface.)
strings.여기가 아틀란티스…. 아나스타샤 시장이 여기 어디쯤 있다고 한 것 같은데: So this is Atlantis... I think they said Mayor Anastasia was somewhere around here...
Who are you? I don't believe I've seen you before...
(A woman in a black coat approaches from in front of a building, noticing the stranger. Her unwavering expression carries an inexplicable chill.)
Oh, I'm %s, an adventurer. Mr. Gatia Su referred me here to Atlantis.
Then you've come to the right place. I am Anastasia, mayor of Atlantis.
Yes, let me explain. I'm looking for Iris...
strings.(아나스타샤에게 헤종의 명과 더불어 이리스를 찾고 있다고 간단하게 이야기: (You briefly explain King Hejong's command and your search for Iris.)
strings.전설의 일족 데르족의 마지막 후예…. 마왕과 대적하고자 여행을 떠났고,: The last descendant of the legendary Tyr people... She set out on a journey to confront the Demon King, and is now missing.
Of course. I met her in person and helped her with her work.
You don't know much about Iris, do you? Perhaps...
Perhaps you wouldn't. In any case...
strings.이리스 양의 여행은 오랜 세월 조용했던 세계를 흔들었고, 많은 변화를 가: Miss Iris's journey shook a world that had been quiet for many years, bringing many changes.
strings.어떻게 말로 표현하기 어렵지만, 확실한 건 많은 이들이 '혼돈'을 느끼고: It is difficult to put into words, but one thing is certain: many people sense chaos.
strings.무슨 말씀인지는 잘 모르겠어요. 도와주신다는 건가요?: I'm not sure I understand. Are you saying you'll help me?
strings.전부가 아닌 아주 약간만 도와드릴 수 있을 것 같습니다. 어디에 있는지: I can offer a little help, though not everything you need. I have no clue where she is now, but I can tell you where she went...
strings.과거의 행로지만 괜찮으시겠습니까?: It is an old trail. Will that suffice?
strings.이리스 양은 제 고향 미드가르드로 향했습니다. 분명 궤도 엘리베이터, ': Miss Iris headed for my hometown, Midgard. She said she would take the orbital elevator, Bifrost, to Asgard.
Getting to Midgard will be harder than you expect. You'll need a map.
Yes. In return, I would like you to carry out a request.
strings.아틀란티스 너머 키마이라 연구소라는 곳이 있습니다. 과거 아틀란티스의 죄: Beyond Atlantis is a place called the Chimera Laboratory. It stands as a symbol of Atlantis's past sins...
I would like you to retrieve a relic from its central chamber.
strings.정확히 어떤 물건이죠?: What exactly am I looking for?
Once you get there, you will know it when you see it.
strings.(뭔가 숨기는 게 있는 거 같아. 일단 가보기나 할까….): (She seems to be hiding something. I suppose I'll go take a look...)
strings.(분위기가 심상치 않은 곳으로 시선을 돌려보니 누군가 몬스터에게 둘러싸여: (You turn toward a place where something feels wrong and see someone surrounded by monsters.)
strings.헤이, 거기 누구 있죠? 있는 거 다 알아! 살려줘!: Hey, is someone there? I know you're there! Help me!
strings.(한 여성이 손을 흔들며 도움을 요청한다. 도와달라는 것치고는 목소리에: (A woman waves, calling for help. For someone in danger, her voice sounds remarkably playful.)
strings.뭐 해, 도와달라니까!: What are you doing? I said, help me!
strings.(몬스터를 밀어내 여성을 구하려는 순간, 여성의 눈빛이 변한다. 들고 있: (Just as you push the monsters back to rescue her, the woman's eyes change. A tremendous volley of bolts erupts from her crossbow.)
strings.정신 차려. 도와주기로 했으면서 정신줄 놓고 있을 거야?: Pay attention. You said you'd help—are you just going to stand there in a daze?
(Soon, every monster in front of you has fallen. A few seem to have fled.)
Whew, all done. You saved me.
strings.(석궁을 든 여성이 활짝 웃으며 악수를 청한다.): (The woman with the crossbow beams and offers her hand.)
strings.뭘요. 그런데 왜 여기에 있었어요?: You're welcome. But what were you doing here?
strings.당신, 아틀란티스에 고용된 모험가지?: You're an adventurer hired by Atlantis, right?
Yes, I'm here on a job.
strings.나도 비슷한 의뢰야. 여기 키마이라 연구소의 상황을 조사해달라고 부탁받았: My job's much the same. I was asked to investigate what's happening in the Chimera Laboratory.
strings.그런데 이런 곳일 줄은 생각조차 못 했어. 위험한데 덥석 물어버린 내가: But I never imagined it would be a place like this. My fault for jumping into something so dangerous.
strings.아나스타샤 시장은 이런 이야기를 안 했다니까. 흥. 사람 쓰는 걸 너무: Mayor Anastasia never mentioned any of this. Hmph. Doesn't she make rather too light of sending people to work for her?
strings.(석궁을 든 여성이 쉬지 않고 불만을 이야기한다.): (The woman with the crossbow pours out complaint after complaint.)
Oh, sorry. I'm talking too much, aren't I? Looking at you closely, you seem pretty capable. Let's go together.
strings.너무 발목 붙잡진 않을게. 나 의외로 쓸모 있으니까 같이 가자. 응?: I won't slow you down too much. I'm more useful than I look, so take me along. Please?
Hmm. This place does seem tougher and more dangerous than I expected...
strings.사양하지 마. 좋은 게 좋은 거 아니겠어?: Don't be shy. All's well that ends well, right?
All right. Since we're both here on laboratory business, let's go together.
strings.(연구소 중심부로 향하는 동안, 석궁을 든 여성이 쉬지 않고 떠든다.): (The woman with the crossbow talks nonstop as you head toward the laboratory's center.)
Let's just say my sister is terribly mean. Ahahaha.
strings.그나저나 여기 고대 아틀란티스 과학기술의 정수가 다 모여있는! 키마이라: Anyway, isn't this supposed to be the Chimera Laboratory, where all the finest achievements of ancient Atlantean science are gathered?
strings.습하고 이상한 냄새 나고 눈 아프고 이상한 것들 잔뜩이고. 고상한 이 몸: It's damp, it smells strange, it hurts my eyes, and it's full of weird things. Hardly a place for someone as refined as me!
I expected something glittering and precious. This is such a disappointment. I'm exhausted...
Yes, what did happen here? Hehe.
strings.문득 아오이치의 벚꽃이 떠오르네. 아아, 그리워라. 호숫가 앞에 앉아서: I'm suddenly reminded of Aoich's cherry blossoms. Ah, I miss them. Sitting by the lake, feeling the cool breeze and falling petals... It was lovely.
strings.응, 나 거기 살았었거든. 추억이라면 추억이지…. 그 아이는 잘 지내고: Yes. I used to live there. Memories, I suppose... I wonder how that child is doing.
strings.(석궁을 든 여성의 미소가 한가득 보인다. 소중한 사람을 떠올린 것 같은: (The woman with the crossbow smiles brightly, as though remembering someone dear to her.)
You think so? Sorry for talking to myself. Shall we get going? Let's hurry.
strings.(후후, 더 늦으면 재미없어질 테니까.): (Hehe. If we're any later, it won't be nearly as entertaining.)
strings.(석궁을 든 여성이 오랫동안 침묵을 지킨다. 그러다 뭔가 할 이야기가 있: (The woman with the crossbow remains silent for a long time. Then she raises a hand, as though she has something to say.)
strings.너 엄청 조용하네. 그러면 내가 이야기해도 될까? 조용히 하자니 좀 심심: You're awfully quiet. Mind if I talk? It's a little boring keeping silent... You'll find it interesting too.
If it's information about the place we're investigating, I'd like to hear it.
strings.그래, 너도 좋아할 거라 생각했어. 여기는 말이지. 정말 불쾌하기 짝이: Good. I thought you would. You see, this place is truly revolting. It's steeped in Atlantis's original sin.
Obsessed with science, the people of Atlantis meddled with something they should never have touched. They did terrible things to the giants here.
strings.여기에 드문드문 남아있는 거인족은 지금 같은 모습이 아니었어. 덩치가 커: The few giants still scattered around here didn't always look like this. They were no different from humans, apart from their size.
They lived quietly in deep mountains and wild lands, alongside other living things... Then the Atlanteans captured them...
strings.(석궁을 든 여인이 손짓으로 뭔가를 보여주려다가 그만둔다.): (The woman starts to illustrate something with her hands, then stops.)
And horrifically transformed them into what they are now. Monsters, you might say...
strings.그리고 그 결과를 바탕으로 자신들이 강해지려고 했지. 정말 그 사람들은: Then they tried to use those results to make themselves stronger. Did they really think they could become gods?
strings.너도 믿어지지 않지? 나도 그래? 하여튼! 그 대가는 파멸에 가까운 재난: You can hardly believe it, can you? Neither can I. Anyway! The price was a catastrophe that nearly destroyed them.
strings.천상 도시의 주인인 아스 신족처럼 되고 싶었던 이들을 아스 신족이 심판했: They wanted to be like the Aesir, masters of the heavenly city. And it was the Aesir who passed judgment on them. Even those gods must have been horrified.
strings.자신들이 이곳을 위해 했던 일들이 이렇게 끔찍하게 될 거라 생각 못했을: They could never have imagined that what they'd done for this land would turn into something so dreadful.
strings.인간의 욕심이란 건 어차피 돌고 돌아. 그들의 과거처럼, 이 땅의 과거처: Human greed always comes full circle. Just like their past, this land's past... and the future that will someday repeat it.
strings.그들의 심판으로 도시는 바다에 떨어졌어. 아마 직접 봤다면 제법 멋진 광: Under their judgment, the city fell into the sea. It must have been quite a sight, don't you think? A magnificent thing. Those who sin must face judgment.
strings.아, 아니야. 하여튼, 지금은 과거의 죄를 잊지 말자, 뭐 그런 의미로: Oh, never mind. Anyway, they seem to have preserved the laboratory as a reminder not to forget their past sins. Something like that.
strings.그런데 말이 되질 않아. 책임을 지려 했다면 여기 증오만 남은 거인들을: But it makes no sense. If they meant to take responsibility, they wouldn't have abandoned these giants with nothing left but hatred.
strings.위선자들…. 어쩌면 나도 위선자일지도 모르겠네. 아니길 바랐는데, 죄인처: Hypocrites... Perhaps I'm a hypocrite too. I hoped I wasn't, but here I am, walking the path of a sinner.
Ahahaha, was that too serious? I get like this sometimes.
strings.이런 이야기 한 거 가지고 너무 고민하지 마. 심각하게 신경도 쓰지 말아: Don't dwell on what I said. Don't take it too seriously, either. All right? Shall we go? We're nearly there.
strings.(석궁을 든 여성이 먼저 앞으로 걸어 나간다. 스쳐 지나간 얼굴에 쓸쓸한: (The woman with the crossbow walks ahead. As she passes, her face is full of loneliness—a sharp contrast to her lively chatter a moment ago.)
strings.(왠지 더 할 말이 있었던 것 같은데. 아, 모르겠다. 일단 여기 일을: (It feels like she had more to say. Oh, I don't know. Let's just finish things here and go back.)
strings.(공간 안에 들어서자마자 석궁을 든 여성의 발걸음이 멈춘다.): (The woman with the crossbow stops as soon as you enter the chamber.)
strings.맞아. 여기가 연구소의 중심부야. 다른 곳보다 좀 더 엄중한 느낌이 나지: That's right. The heart of the laboratory. It feels a little more heavily guarded than the rest, doesn't it?
strings.여기서 찾을 게 있다고 했지? 그럼 찾아보고 있어. 그동안 나도 할 일을: You said you had something to find, right? Go look for it. I'll take care of my own business in the meantime.
strings.(석궁을 든 여성이 콧노래를 부르며 안을 살펴본다. 그리고 안쪽에 있던: (Humming to herself, the woman with the crossbow looks around. Then she begins fiddling with a machine farther inside.)
strings.여기 왜 이렇게 줄들이 많지. 넘어질뻔 했잖아…. 엉?: Why are there so many cables here? I almost tripped... Huh?
strings.(눈앞에 수상한 상자가 놓여 있다.): (A suspicious box sits in front of you.)
Is this it? A Chimera Core Box...
This must be it, but it's empty. I hope the contents are somewhere nearby...
strings.찾는 게 없어?: Can't find what you're looking for?
strings.(석궁을 든 여성이 품 안에서 뭔가를 꺼내 %s에게 보여준다.): (The woman with the crossbow takes something from inside her coat and shows it to %s.)
strings.아, 그거…. 상자 안에 있던 것 같아요. 제가 확인하게 잠깐 주시겠어요: Oh, that... I think that was in the box. Could you give it to me for a moment so I can check?
strings.이거 뭔지 알아? '인간'의 모습을 닮은 인형을 그대로 만드는 '키마이라: Do you know what this is? A Chimera core, used to create dolls in the exact likeness of humans.
strings.아틀란티스는 이런 걸 왜 만든 걸까? 그리고 왜 저런 곳에 넣어둔 걸까?: Why did Atlantis make such a thing? And why did they put it in there? To make more someday? I suppose they still haven't let go of their desire to become gods.
strings.타락하려는 인간이 만든 존재가 얼마나 불쌍한지 모르는 것도 아닐텐데 말이: Surely they know how pitiful the beings made by humans on the path to corruption are. The proof is all around us.
They do seem to feel some shame, sending you to retrieve this...
strings.(석궁을 든 여성의 분위기가 달라진다. 묘한 위화감마저 느껴진다.): (The air around the woman with the crossbow changes. Something about her feels disturbingly wrong.)
Fine, I'll give it to you. Here, catch.
strings.(석궁을 든 여성이 %s에게 들고 있던 소체를 던진다.): (The woman with the crossbow tosses the core she was holding to %s.)
strings.잘 들어. 화내지 마. 이거 내가 썼어. 후후, 아나스타샤, 그 여자에게: Listen carefully. Don't get angry. I used it. Hehe... Make sure you tell that woman Anastasia.
strings.초엔 팜이 키마이라 소켓을 사용했다고. 아나스타샤가 이걸 알면 어떤 표정: Tell her Choen Palm used the Chimera socket. I wonder what face Anastasia will make when she hears. Hehe.
strings.(정신을 압박하고 있는 이 공포감….): (This terror, pressing down on my mind...)
That's right. I'm Choen Palm. The one who's going to put a hole through that thick skull of yours.
It's irritating, seeing you hold out like that...
strings.이렇게 된 거 빨리 끝내줄게. 여기서 나를 만난 걸 불운으로 여기렴!!: Now that it's come to this, I'll finish you quickly. Consider it your bad luck to have met me here!
strings.놀이 상대로는 그만이지만, 너 왜 이렇게 쓰러지지 않아?: You're perfect to play with, but why won't you fall?
strings.나에게 왜 그러는 거죠?: Why are you doing this to me?
strings.몰라서 물어? 그렇다면 똑똑히 알게 해주지. 응? 뭐야?: You really don't know? Then I'll make it perfectly clear. Hm? What's this?
strings.(초엔 팜이 공격을 멈추고 바깥쪽을 바라본다. 누군가의 인기척을 느낀 듯: (Choen Palm stops attacking and looks toward the exit, apparently sensing someone's presence.)
strings.여기서 대체 무슨 일이…. 다, 당신은 초엔 팜?!: What on earth is happening here...? Y-you're Choen Palm?!
As clueless and troublesome as ever, aren't you?
strings.당신은 그런 말을 할 자격이 없습니다!: You have no right to say that!
strings.(아나스타샤가 검을 들어 초엔 팜에게 달려든다.): (Anastasia raises a sword and charges at Choen Palm.)
strings.(아나스타샤의 검이 어디서 나온 거지? 초엔 팜도 저 검을 순식간에 피하: (Where did Anastasia's sword come from? And Choen Palm dodged it in an instant...)
It's my first time seeing that black blade, but it won't work on me. You know that, Anastasia.
strings.당신, 여기서 대체 무슨 짓을 하는 거죠?: What exactly are you doing here?
strings.당신이 보는 그대로야. 아틀란티스의 추하고 썩은 과거 행적에 관심이 있었: Just what it looks like. I was interested in Atlantis's ugly, rotten past. That's all.
You're all such a nuisance. I'll stop here. I'm leaving.
strings.잘 들어, 어디서 왔는지 모르는 모험가님. 내 공격을 버틴 건 칭찬해 줄: Listen, adventurer from who knows where. I'll give you credit for withstanding my attacks. But don't get the wrong idea—I'm not leaving because you're too much for me.
strings.그리고 이리스를 찾겠다는 생각 같은 건 하지 마. 절대 찾을 수 없을 테: And don't even think about looking for Iris. You'll never find her.
strings.내가 왜 이리스를 찾을 수 없을 거로 생각하죠?: Why do you think I won't be able to find Iris?
strings.(초엔 팜의 표정이 살짝 일그러지지만, 금방 여유 있는 모습으로 돌아온다: (Choen Palm's expression twists slightly, then quickly returns to its usual composure.)
strings.(갑자기 주위에 알 수 없는 어둠이 몰려든다. 초엔 팜이 서둘러 삼켜지듯: (An unfamiliar darkness suddenly gathers around you. Choen Palm quickly steps into it, as though being swallowed.)
strings.여전히 방심할 수 없는 여자군요. 그나저나 괜찮으십니까?: Still a woman one can never let one's guard down around. More importantly, are you all right?
strings.그렇군요. 죄송합니다만, 여기에서 일어난 일을 설명해주실 수 있을까요?: I see. I'm sorry, but could you explain what happened here?
strings.(아나스타샤에게 있었던 일을 간단하게 설명한다.): (You briefly explain what happened to Anastasia.)
strings.(아나스타샤가 뭔가 알아차린 듯 안쪽에 있던 장치들을 만지기 시작한다.): (As though realizing something, Anastasia begins operating the devices farther inside.)
What Choen Palm tampered with was...
Choen Palm was after information on the [Homunculus] Project...
strings.죄송합니다. 그건…. 아, 아닙니다. 말씀드리겠습니다. 이게 아틀란티스의: I'm sorry. That's... No, I'll tell you. Atlantis's affairs caused this, and you've become involved. You deserve to know.
strings.호문클루스 프로젝트란… 당신께 회수를 의뢰했던 키마이라 소체, 그것을 이: The Homunculus Project... It was a project to create [artificial humans] using the Chimera core I asked you to recover.
strings.그걸 왜 구해 오라고 하신 거죠?: Why did you ask me to get it?
strings.제대로 보관해두고 싶었기 때문입니다. 과거의 일을 반성하기 위해…. 하지: I wanted to store it securely. As a reminder of our past wrongdoing... But Choen Palm seems intent on using it.
To do such a thing, when she looks on this place with such disgust...
Judging by the condition of the case, this seems to have been done quite some time ago.
strings.지금 초엔 팜이 무슨 일을 할지 모르고, 여기서 할 수 있는 일도 없군요: We don't know what Choen Palm intends, and there's nothing more we can do here. Shall we return for now?
strings.(일단 아틀란티스로 돌아가자. 초엔 팜의 말이 신경 쓰이지만….): (Let's return to Atlantis. Though what Choen Palm said still bothers me...)
I've gathered what information I can, but I still don't know why Choen Palm is doing this.
strings.저는 저대로 계속 알아보겠습니다. 그러니 당신은 당신대로 가던 길을 가시: I'll continue investigating. You should continue on your own path. And here is the map...
Thank you for the map. Where should I go, then? I'm looking for Iris...
She definitely mentioned cherry blossoms... Maybe...
I'll be going. I may be able to learn something...
Then take care on your way...
strings.(흑월성 앞이 어수선하다. 흑월성주가 성 밖에서 골치 아픈 표정으로 뭔가: (There is a commotion outside Dark Moon Castle. The Dark Moon Lord stands outside, looking troubled and deep in thought.)
Ahhh, she may be my daughter, but she does whatever she pleases.
strings.오, %s! 자네가 웬일인가?! 잘 왔어!! 덕분에 건강해졌거든. 아하하: Oh, %s! What brings you here?! Welcome! Thanks to you, I'm in good health. Ahahaha!
strings.그렇지 않아도 다시 올 것 같았는데, 오늘일 줄이야. 나도 참 운이 좋다: I thought you'd visit again, but I didn't expect it to be today. What luck!
strings.그동안 잘 지냈나? 흑월성에 다시 온 걸 보니 분명 무슨 일이 있는 거겠: Have you been well? If you've come back to Dark Moon Castle, there must be a reason.
Yes... Though I'm not sure whether I should tell you...
strings.(흑월성주에게 초엔 팜을 만났던 이야기를 전한다.): (You tell the Dark Moon Lord about meeting Choen Palm.)
strings.짐작은 했지만…. 초엔, 그 아이의 이야기였군. 그 아이를 만났단 말이지: I suspected as much... So it's about Choen. You met that girl, then.
strings.공주한테는 전하고 싶진 않지만, 그래도 그 아이가 원하고 있으니…. 어쩔: I'd rather not tell the princess, but she wants to know... I suppose there's no choice.
strings.그러면 자네가 공주에게 직접 말을 전달해주게. 일단은 공주가 자네에게 고: Then please tell the princess yourself. Though she'll be more willing to listen if she has reason to be grateful to you first.
I know she doesn't think very well of me, but...
strings.(성주님께서 뭔가 일을 시키실 것 같은데….): (I have a feeling he's about to put me to work...)
strings.지금 공주는 올빼미 성에 숨어있는 나쁜 세력의 잔당을 물리치고 있어. 아: The princess is currently clearing out the remnants of an evil faction hiding in Owl Castle. She went in saying, “Father, I'll take care of everything”...
strings.그래도 걱정이 돼서 말이지. 하하하. 좋은 게 좋은 거 아니겠나?: But I can't help worrying. Hahaha. No harm in lending a hand, is there?
strings.안에 들어가서 공주님을 도와드리면 되는 거죠?: You want me to go inside and help her, right?
strings.그렇지. 부탁해도 될까?: Exactly. May I ask that of you?
strings.부탁하네. 그리고 미안하네. 분명 공주가 격한 반응을 보일 거야. 그대에: Please do. And I'm sorry. The princess is bound to react strongly. She doesn't mean any ill toward you...
Don't worry. I'll pass the message on.
I'll be on my way, then.
strings.(한참을 들어가자 흑월공주가 보인다. 공주는 자객들에게 둘러싸여 대치 중: (After making your way deep inside, you spot the Dark Moon Princess. She appears to be in a standoff, surrounded by assassins.)
strings.어, 너…. 이거 우연이 너무 겹치는 걸. 혹시 도우러 온 거야?: Oh, you... This is rather too many coincidences. Did you come to help?
strings.(분명 위기 상황인데, 너무 태연하게 묻는단 말이지….): (She's clearly in danger, yet she asks so casually...)
strings.(흑월공주의 활이 %s의 뒤에서 나타난 자객을 정확히 명중한다.): (The Dark Moon Princess's arrow strikes an assassin who has appeared behind %s.)
strings.후우, 여긴 됐어. 내가 알아서 할게. 도울 거면 도망친 백건당의 잔당을: Whew. This area's handled. I can take care of it. If you want to help, chase the remaining White Hood members who fled.
strings.그래, 혹시 모르니까 이야기해줄게. 텐구 님이 주술에 속박당했어. 그러니: Right. I'll tell you, just in case. Lord Tengu has been bound by a spell. So if you do run into him—if you really do—run away immediately. Understand?
He's not someone you can handle.
strings.그대…. 꽤 괜찮은 실력이군. 한 번 더 봐도 괜찮겠나?: You... have considerable skill. May I see a little more of it?
strings.그대는 이 상황에서도 나를 걱정하는 건가?: Even in this situation, you are concerned for me?
I thought the princess would come, but this is rather sooner than expected.
If that is your wish, Princess, I shall stop.
strings.(텐구가 뒤로 물러나 눈을 감고 작은 소리로 중얼거린다.): (Tengu steps back, closes his eyes, and murmurs quietly.)
strings.(흑월공주가 당황한 표정으로 작아진 텐구의 모습을 바라본다.): (The Dark Moon Princess stares at the now-small Tengu, looking bewildered.)
strings.텐구 님, 주술에 지배당한 거 아니었어?: Lord Tengu, weren't you being controlled by a spell?
strings.흐음, 공주. 날 너무 과소평가하는 거 아닌가? 공주의 부모, 그 선대: Hmm, Princess. Aren't you underestimating me? Even your parents and their ancestors would struggle to control me.
strings.그러면 조금 전까지 강력한 기운을 풍기며 싸운 건 뭔데?: Then why were you fighting with that overwhelming power a moment ago?
I saw someone with the potential to become a tengu, so I decided to test them briefly.
strings.텐구가 될 소질?: The potential to become a tengu?
Haha, don't concern yourself with that. You have much to do in the days ahead.
Honestly, you made me worry for nothing.
Thank you, Princess. You're growing into a fine young woman.
strings.(텐구가 흑월공주와 이런저런 이야기를 나누더니 %s의 얼굴을 바라본다.): (After exchanging a few words with the Dark Moon Princess, Tengu turns his gaze toward %s.)
strings.어, 텐구 님? 왜 그러시죠?: Oh, Lord Tengu? What is it?
strings.그대…, 뭔가 전할 이야기가 있는 거 아닌가?: You... have something to tell us, don't you?
Why hesitate? Just say it. I'll listen.
strings.(흑월공주와 텐구에게 초엔 팜을 만났던 이야기를 한다.): (You tell the Dark Moon Princess and Tengu about meeting Choen Palm.)
strings.(흑월공주의 얼굴이 살짝 창백해지자, 텐구가 공주의 상태를 살핀다.): (The princess's face pales slightly. Tengu looks at her with concern.)
Lord Tengu, please be quiet for a moment.
Choen must have a reason. She has to! Don't speak ill of her...
strings.이건 다 이리스, 그 아이가 잘못했기 때문이야. 이리스의 어리석음으로 세: This is all Iris's fault! Her foolishness put the world in danger!
strings.나는 분명히 봤어. 시공 저편에서 이리스 때문에 나타난 많은 [마왕]의: I saw it myself. The many [Demon Kings] that appeared beyond time and space because of Iris...
strings.(공주는 대체 뭘 본 거지…?): (What in the world did the princess see...?)
Choen wanted to stop that. The things she's doing now, too...
strings.조용히 해, 텐구 님!! 몰라!! 듣기 싫다고!! 초엔을 찾아야 해. 뭘: Be quiet, Lord Tengu! I don't know! I don't want to hear it! I have to find Choen. I don't know what she's doing, but if I don't go and see her... Maybe...
strings.(흑월공주가 말이 끝나자마자 서둘러 밖으로 나간다.): (No sooner has she finished speaking than the Dark Moon Princess hurries outside.)
strings.가련한 공주…. 믿고 싶지 않은 말에 매달리다니…. 그 불꽃 병아리 녀석: Poor princess... Clinging to words she cannot bear to doubt... I should have roasted that fiery little chick properly when it showed up.
Perhaps things will be all right, at least for a while. The course of the heavens is never wholly ill-fated.
strings.그대, 흑월공주와 또 연이 된다면, 친구가 되어주거라. 강한 척 하지만,: If your paths cross again, be a friend to the Dark Moon Princess. She acts strong, but she has a tender heart.
strings.자, 이번에는 여기서 안녕이다. 어차피 머지 않아 또 만나게 될 듯하니: Well, this is goodbye for now. I suspect we'll meet again before long. Until then.
Oh, yes. Go see Tamori. There will be something for you to do.
strings.(말이 끝나자마자 텐구가 어디선가 불어오는 바람을 타고 사라진다.): (As soon as he finishes, Tengu vanishes on a breeze that blows from nowhere.)
strings.그나저나 이 바람, 부드러워…. 그런데 내가 할 일이라는 게 뭘까?: What a gentle breeze... But what is it I'm supposed to do?
I need to follow the princess...
strings.(아메를 쫓던 저 사람이 타모리였지? ): (That person who was chasing Ame was Tamori, right?)
strings.아, 당신. 방금 공주님을 만나러 갔었던 거지?: Oh, you. You just went to see the princess, didn't you?
strings.공주님이 격해져서 나가셨어. 초엔을 만나야 한다면서…. 무슨 일 있었던: She left in a state, saying she had to find Choen... Did something happen?
strings.주군, 제가 가서 공주님을 모셔오겠습니다. 공주님이 저 정도로 격해지신다: My lord, I will go and bring the princess back. If she is that upset...
Whew. I have something for you to do here.
strings.%s, 자네가 공주를 쫓아가 주게. 초엔에 관련된 일이라 지금 아무것도: %s, please follow her. When Choen is involved, she can neither see nor hear anything else.
strings.공주가 그동안 아무에게도 이야기하지 않았던 뭔가가 있는 것 같아. 그냥: I think there's something she hasn't told anyone all this time. If it were simply news of Choen, perhaps... But...
She's learned something about what Choen intends to do...
...Then perhaps it could be connected to Iris...
strings.그럴 수도 있고, 아닐 수도 있네. 확실한 건 공주는 초엔을 만나러 이리: Perhaps, perhaps not. But one thing is certain: she'll be going to the place she visited with Miss Iris, hoping to find Choen.
strings.답을 얻기 위해 아스 신족을 만나러 가려고 했던 미드가르드…. 쿨럭, 쿨: Midgard... Where they went to seek answers from the Aesir. Cough, cough.
If you don't know where she went, find Shino at the tavern. She's from Aoich. Tell her I sent you, and she'll understand.
I'm sorry to have to ask this of you.
It's all right. I'll go right away.
strings.(시끌벅적한 미드가르드의 주점. 안쪽, 아오이치 전통 의상을 입은 미인이: (The tavern in Midgard is bustling. Inside, a beautiful woman in traditional Aoich clothing moves busily among the guests.)
Are you Miss Shino? I've come from Dark Moon Castle...
strings.성주님께서 무슨 일이 있으신 건가요?: Has something happened to the lord?
No, he asked me to pass on his regards while I was here.
I see. Still, you look as though there's something you want to know.
strings.혹시 흑월공주님이 어디로 가셨는지 아시나요?: Do you know where the Dark Moon Princess went?
strings.공주님께서 초엔이란 사람을 찾고 있는 건 아니겠지요?: Surely the princess isn't looking for someone called Choen?
strings.저도 잘 모르니 이어 말씀하시지 않아도 됩니다. 대신 다른 걸 알려드리겠: I don't know much myself, so you needn't say any more. Let me tell you something else instead.
strings.얼마 전, 비프로스트 안으로 짧은 머리의 여성이 들어갔다는 이야기를 들었: Not long ago, I heard that a short-haired woman entered Bifrost. She was carrying a crossbow, so...
Thank you, Miss Shino. I'll head straight to Bifrost.
I was going to tell you the orbital elevator was broken, but you've already left...
strings.(알 수 없는 불길한 느낌이 가득한 장소, 발할라의 정상. 초엔 팜이 일: (At the summit of Valhalla, a place steeped in an inexplicable sense of foreboding, Choen Palm stares at the sky, her expression twisted.)
strings.용케도 여기까지 왔네? 오늘따라 날 찾는 손님이 왜 이렇게 많은 걸까?: You managed to get all the way here? Why do I have so many visitors today?
I wish the princess hadn't come... This is the worst.
strings.(초엔 팜이 쓰러져 있는 흑월공주를 쳐다본다.): (Choen Palm looks at the Dark Moon Princess, who lies on the ground.)
strings.공주, 넌 방해가 되니까 치울 거야♬ 아파도 참아, 알았지?: Princess, you're in my way, so I'll have to move you aside. ♬ Bear with the pain, all right?
strings.(초엔 팜이 웃으면서 다가오는 흑월공주의 복부에 주먹을 날린다.): (Smiling, Choen Palm punches the Dark Moon Princess in the stomach as she approaches.)
Good girl, Princess. Just go to sleep for now.
strings.(초엔 팜이 정신을 잃은 흑월공주를 한쪽에 뉘어놓는다. 그리고 불청객인: (Choen Palm lays the unconscious princess to one side, then turns to the uninvited adventurer.)
strings.(여기에서 느꼈던 불길한 힘…. 초엔 팜의 것이었어.): (The ominous power I felt here... It was Choen Palm's.)
Welcome to Valhalla, adventurer summoned by the Tyr.
strings.용케 여기까지 기어 올라왔구나? 이리스가 선택했다면 확실히 다르긴 다른가: You've done well to crawl all the way up here. If Iris chose you, I suppose you really must be different.
strings.자신이 '정의'라 믿고 여기까지 온 거겠지?: You came all this way believing you stand for justice, didn't you?
strings.넌 자각이 없어도 너무 없어. 무슨 일을 하는 지도 모르고, 뭘 위한 건: You're utterly oblivious. You don't know what you're doing, or what it's for.
strings.그저 가로 막고 있는 존재들을 다 쓰러뜨리지. 세계의 진실 같은 건 모를: You simply strike down everything that stands in your way. You know nothing of the truth of this world.
strings.이 세상이 알고 있는 선과 악, 그리고 빛과 그림자…. 모두 모순이란 걸: The good and evil this world knows, its light and shadow... All contradictions. Perhaps a greenhorn like you is better off not knowing.
strings.이 [세상]에서 죽어간 몬스터들이 과연 너에게는 당연히 사냥당해 마땅한: All the monsters that have died in this [world]... Were they truly [evil] that deserved to be hunted down by you?
strings.기분이 너무 더럽다고!!: It makes me feel absolutely filthy!
strings.(초엔 팜의 몸에서 푸른 불꽃이 피어오른다.): (Blue flames rise from Choen Palm's body.)
strings.죄인의 몸으로 온 이상, 제대로 죄를 지어줄게. 자, 모험가님, 내가 당: Since I've come here as a sinner, I'll commit a proper sin. Now, Adventurer, I have a gift for you.
strings.(푸른 불꽃이 점점 커지면서 초엔 팜을 감싸기 시작한다. 잠시 후, 거대: (The blue flames grow, beginning to envelop Choen Palm. A moment later, an enormous bird rises from within them.)
Don't thank me. You deserve it.
I'll give you the flames of punishment, the judgment of purification...
strings.(접전 끝에 새가 품고 있던 푸른 불꽃이 점점 옅어진다. 잠시 후, 그: (After a fierce battle, the bird's blue flames gradually fade. Little by little, Choen Palm's form becomes visible within them.)
You think it's over? Arrogant creature...
strings.(초엔 팜의 목소리와 함께 옅어졌던 푸른 불꽃이 다시 타오른다.): (At Choen Palm's words, the fading blue flames flare up again.)
strings.정말 어리석어. 지금 누구와 싸웠는 지도 모르지? 이해하지도 못하면서 그: What a fool. You don't even know who you were fighting, do you? Holding out like that without understanding a thing...
strings.이렇게 된 김에 새로 얻은 힘을 시험해볼까? 너라면 이번에도 버틸 수 있: Since it's come to this, shall I test my newfound power? Can you endure it this time too?
I'll show you the true form of an Agasura.
strings.(초엔 팜의 말끝에서 거대한 힘의 움직임이 느껴진다.): (As Choen Palm finishes speaking, you sense a tremendous power stirring.)
strings.(지금까지 느끼지 못했던 전혀 다른 힘이야. 이건 마치….): (This is completely different from anything I've felt before. It's like...)
strings.심연이 느껴져? 느껴지냐고?!: Can you feel the abyss? Can you?!
(Is that endless depth the abyss? It feels like someone is reaching out... It makes my skin crawl. What is this...?)
strings.(%s에게로 알 수 없는 힘이 다가와 감싸기 시작한다.): (An unknown power approaches %s and begins to envelop you.)
Feel how unjust they are—the justice and providence you've believed in.
Then crawl beneath the darkness. Forever, never able to rise again...
strings.(흐려지는 의식 속에 들려오는 누군가의 목소리와 함께 %s의 다리가 풀린: (As a voice reaches your fading consciousness, %s's legs give way. Then Choen Palm screams and begins writhing in pain.)
Urgh... What happened? I feel better... Was that voice a hallucination? But Choen Palm...
strings.(초엔 팜 앞에 흐릿한 소년의 모습이 보인다. 마치 영혼처럼 느껴지는 환: (The faint figure of a boy appears before Choen Palm. He seems like an apparition, almost a spirit.)
strings.(이리스? 아냐. 이리스와 비슷한 느낌이지만…. 저 아이는 이리스가 아냐: (Iris? No. He feels similar to Iris, but... That boy isn't Iris.)
strings.감히, 감히…. 인형 주제에 날…. 내 머릿속에서 나가!! 크랙으로 삭제: How dare you... A mere doll, doing this to me... Get out of my head! I thought I'd erased you with the Crack! I thought I'd destroyed you! Why are you coming out of there?!
strings.[…내가 아직도 당신이 만든 인형으로 보여? 가련한 아이….]: [...Do you still see me as a doll you made? You poor child...]
strings.(초엔 팜의 입에서 피가 흐르기 시작한다.): (Blood begins to run from Choen Palm's mouth.)
strings.(입술을 지그시 깨문 초엔 팜이 비틀거리며 밖으로 나가려 한다.): (Biting her lip, Choen Palm staggers toward the exit.)
Consider yourself lucky that I'm retreating like this.
Next time, everyone involved will die. No, they have to die! Cough, cough...
strings.(초엔 팜이 쓰러져있는 흑월공주를 잠시 응시하다 이내 사라진다.): (Choen Palm gazes briefly at the fallen Dark Moon Princess, then disappears.)
strings.초엔이 가진 힘은 대체 뭐지…?: What exactly is the power Choen possesses...?
And that boy who appeared... I don't know.
strings.(흑월공주가 흐느끼다 그대로 기절했는지 더는 목소리가 들리지 않는다.): (The Dark Moon Princess sobs, then falls silent, apparently losing consciousness again.)
I'd better get the princess out of here. If I take her to Miss Shino...
strings.(흑월공주를 부축하자 눈가에 맺혀있던 눈물이 아오이치에서 봤던 벚꽃잎처럼: (As you support the Dark Moon Princess, the tears gathered at her eyes scatter like the cherry petals you saw in Aoich, falling far below the orbital structure.)
